name: ttzf-payment-provider
title: Replace Vexutopia with TTZF payment integration
description: Replace retired Vexutopia with TTZF epay only; preserve atomic credits/VIP fulfilment, secure GET notification, query recovery and historical order isolation.
creator: cline

mobile_performance.notes: No visible Android/iOS page or API samples; baselines are null, never zero. Planning goals only: 3000 ms page/create, 1500 ms order detail evaluated separately.
